productConcept.name: Quill Plane Instrument Co.
productConcept.description: A precision calibration instrument manufacturer founded in 1971 in Stroud, Gloucestershire, producing the QP-7 Fold Endurance Tester and QP-12 Thickness Comparator for conservation studios, archival binderies, and European paper mills.
productConcept.rationale: The #f2f2f2 page-background is the exact luminance of uncoated 120gsm Rives BFK paper under north light. The light-dominant palette, Lora editorial serif, and restrained spacing system map precisely to a precision instruments studio where measurement is the aesthetic — no ornament, no chromatic interruption, only calibrated surfaces and controlled proportions.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — stone-ledger motion system with 1.125s slow duration, scrub-based parallax references in concept_by_video.md, and named GSAP techniques (scattered assembly, clip-path bloom, SVG line draw, elastic magnetic hover, number counters, word-rotation stagger)
